title: Orsen and the Deadline
author: Ines Delacroix
blurb: Freya Winterbourne, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
